Kyoto Trip Plan (October 2026):
Day 1: South Kyoto. Start at Fushimi Inari Taisha at 6:00 AM sharp to walk the torii gate mountain trail before tour buses arrive. Afternoon at Tofuku-ji zen garden. Evening dinner at Gyoza Hohei in Gion (expect 45 min wait).
Day 2: Arashiyama. Tenryu-ji bamboo grove at 7:30 AM, monkey park hill climb, and lunch at Shigetsu temple vegetarian restaurant.
Day 3: Northern temples. Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion) opens at 9:00 AM, followed by Ryoan-ji rock garden.
